## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `annotations` (Attributes Set) Annotation (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--annotations))

- `display_name` (String) Branch display name

- `parent_timestamp` (String) Timestamp of derivation from the parent branch
- `password` (String) Branch root password, only for setting or changing the password (not returned after writing)
- `project_name` (String) Name of the project to which the IP address pool belongs
- `reset_branch` (Boolean) Reset branch. Resetting briefly changes the branch status before returning to READY; only used to trigger actions (no return value)
- `state` (String) Branch status (e.g., CREATING, READY)
- `update_time` (String) Update time
- `usages` (Attributes) Branch resource usage (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--usages))
